ticket.title: common had no verification chain entry, so its tasks verified with the workspace chain and no cargo checks
acceptance_criteria:
DONE 2026-11-06. `miter audit` is now in the verification chain, and the investigation changed what I thought the ticket was.

The record, since the question was whether audit had been gated before: it never was. `git log -S 'miter audit'` across all twelve repositories finds it only in miter's own documentation commits (README and ARCHITECTURE describing the command) and in this session's ledger notes. It appears in no verification_commands history. So the rule lived in documentation and in habit, never in a chain - which is exactly why it was repaired by hand twice: GB-220 split two files pushed over by GB-215, and GB-291 split nine, seven of which this session pushed over.

What changed:
- the generator (default_verification_commands in storypole-cli) emits `miter audit --path . --threshold 250` between nextest and the docs check, with the two incidents recorded beside it so the next reader knows why it is there
- all eleven configs carry it: ten member repositories commit their own, and the root map carries the workspace chain
- AGENTS.md names it in Tier 2, Tier 3 and the commit step, so the documented matrix and the executed chain finally agree

Proof it bites rather than assumed: `miter audit --path storypole --threshold 250` exits 0 and the same command at --threshold 200 exits 1, so a && chain stops on it.

Separate gap found while wiring it: `common` is a member repository with no entry in the verification map. Verifying a common-scoped task matched the repo name, found nothing, and fell through to `default` - the workspace chain, which runs contracts, lockfiles, audit and docs but no cargo commands at all. Common's crates were never compile-gated by verify. A chain entry now exists.

Also confirmed in passing: the root git add was aborted by the ignored member paths and staged nothing, which is the GB-150 failure mode recorded in AGENTS.md law 6. Caught by reading the output rather than assuming the commit landed; the member configs were committed in their own repositories instead.

Gates: docs 108/108 0 drifted, contracts 0 drift, 11/11 lockfiles, layers clean (1 lateral), storypole 64 tests green, config check --workspace 10 repositories 0 findings.
